revisions.body: Columns C1 to C4, beams B1 to B4 and slab F2 on Story1, with fixed bases at joints 1 to 4.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Add section types, releases, loads and combos
revisions.body: Two column types, a concrete beam type with a different f'c material, two pinned column bases, a steel beam at 0.5 EI in I22 and I33, a pinned end release, D and L load patterns, two load combos, a dead UDL and a live point frame load, and a dummy mass source.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.body: Resize C3 to W16X36, rotate C1 90 deg, and switch Conc16x10 to 6 ksi.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Export Hack_v02 in lb and ft
revisions.body: Same model as Hack_v02, saved in lb-ft units instead of kip-in. Should diff clean against Hack_v02.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Extend B1 to B7 and add beams B5 and B8
revisions.body: Replace B1 with a longer Conc24x10 beam B7 (300 in) from the same start point, with its dead load now trapezoidal over the first 80% and the live point load moved to 0.4. Add W18X60 beam B5 and a Conc16x10 cantilever B8 off the back right corner. All on Story1.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Copy Story1 framing up to Story2
revisions.body: Add columns C1 to C4, beams B2, B3, B4, B5, B7 and B8, and slab F2 on Story2, with the same sections and the same loads on B2 and B7.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Remove B5 on Story2 and fix base joint 1
revisions.body: Remove B5 at Story2, set the C2 rigid zone factor to 1.0 at Story2, raise the B7 live point load at Story2 from 5 to 10 kip, and fix all six DOF at base joint 1.
revisions.author: Hackathon team

revisions.summary: Edit materials and add section Conc16x10_5ksi
revisions.body: Drop A992Fy50 E from 29000 to 20000 ksi (17 steel members affected), set 6Ksi weight to 0, add material 5ksi and section Conc16x10_5ksi, move B2 at Story2 onto it, and rotate B7 at Story1 90 deg.
revisions.author: Hackathon team
